title: A Development Set's expectations: .private/work/walk-expect/<set>.json
description: The limits scripts/walk/verdict.py judges a walk's eight checks by (docs/specs/factory.md 5 'G1'; the owner's Q5 refined limits, 5 Oct 2026): from Q5's limits and the Answer Key's counts, never from a walk's own recording; prepared by drawing-analyst, reviewed by qs-critic, the counts confirmed by the owner. Private; never in git: the structures name real files and Sheet numbers, so no test, issue or PR holds one. A missing key makes the checks that need it UNSET, and UNSET fails PASS: files for reads_complete; p95_ms_max, act_max_ms and act_samples_min for act_p95_during_read; questions_max_per_discipline for questions_per_discipline; sheets_per_discipline and phantom_sheets_max for sheets_match; true_questions for true_questions_raised; false_continuation_max, stale_title_grouped_max and stale_title_pairs for false_continuations; bulk_confirmable_share_min and sheets_per_discipline for bulk_confirmable_share; storeys_wrong_max and storeys for storeys_match. A wrong shape, a negative or non-integer count, a share above 1 or an unknown key is malformed: nothing is judged.

sheet.description: A Sheet by its file's name as uploaded and its Sheet number.

files.description: How many files the set holds; every one must be read.

p95_ms_max.description: The act p95 limit, in ms, while a later file reads.

act_max_ms.description: The worst act's limit, in ms, while a later file reads.

act_samples_min.description: Acts of each kind (confirm, undo, exclude, answer) the walk must time while a read runs.

questions_max_per_discipline.description: Q5: machine-doubt Questions per Discipline (open Questions not on true_questions, numbering gaps once per file).

bulk_confirmable_share_min.description: Q5: per Discipline, the Sheets the QS can confirm in bulk over N (sheets_per_discipline).

false_continuation_max.description: Q5: open conflict Questions (same_title, same_storey, same_number) not on true_questions.

phantom_sheets_max.description: Sheets found beyond N, or in a Discipline not listed (or none).

stale_title_grouped_max.description: Listed stale-title pairs grouped silently (equal titles, no Question holding both).

storeys_wrong_max.description: Listed storey-bearing Sheets whose storeys the product reads otherwise.

sheets_per_discipline.description: N: the true Sheet count of each Discipline, every Sheet (one proposed out and an empty layout too).

true_questions.description: The true defects the product must raise (outside the machine-doubt cap): a Question matches when its code or check_code is `code`, its Discipline is `discipline` and it holds a Sheet for every listed one. An empty list means none.

stale_title_pairs.description: Pairs of Sheets whose titles are equal though they are not one series: a Question of any kind must hold both (stale_title_grouped_max counts those none holds). List each pair in true_questions too, as a same_title conflict over its two Sheets: only an open or answered same_title conflict holding exactly those two raises it (true_questions_raised), whatever titles the product reads.

storeys.description: Each storey-bearing Sheet and its true storeys (order ignored); a Sheet not listed is never judged.
